choices.content: Inspecting all components of a spacecraft before launch
Giving new students medical examinations upon enrollment
Testing the lethal radius of a batch of artillery shells

question.prompt: Which of the following investigations is most suitable for sampling?

solutions.explanation: Testing the lethal radius of artillery shells is destructive, so not all shells can be tested and sampling must be used. The other three investigations require examining every member of the population.
solutions.title: Recognize destructive testing
